The '''Mother Lode Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Work Zone sector]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith's]] capital city, [[Prak City]]. It was run by a reclusive female [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and was habituated by the city's construction workers and [[Mining/Legends|miners]], notably the old owner of the [[Geddis mine]], [[Myrum Geddis]].
